checkpoints.name: forrelation_pseudorandom
checkpoints.description: Theorem 10 of KQST23 (arXiv 2212.00879v2): exists K > 0 such that for all n >= 1, for the discrete Forrelation distribution F_n of Definition 8 (f uniform; g(x) independently +-1 with bias trnc(sqrt(eps 2^n) fhat(x)), eps = 1/(100n)), every Boolean C on 2N variables whose +-1-restrictions have level-2 Fourier mass <= t satisfies |E_{F_n}[C] - E_unif[C]| <= K * max(t,1) * ln N / sqrt(N) (see tests/reference/concept-ledger.md).
